documents.text:
# Willow music circle — current rules
The current circle has five rehearsal places. This replaces the retired edition. Members may revise their outline before the coordinator's review without asking permission. Revisions after that review require the coordinator's approval. A digital outline is required; printing it is optional. These rules do not name a funder or set a fee.

documents.name: Willow retired.md
documents.text:
# Willow music circle — retired rules
This retired edition offered nine rehearsal places. The current rules replace it.

documents.name: Orchard library.md
documents.text:
# Orchard library loans
A loan lasts seven days. A reader may renew it once if nobody else has reserved the book. A reservation prevents renewal. This note does not state overdue charges. The librarian records the checkout date and the renewal date separately.

documents.name: Paper sculpture.md
documents.text:
# Building a paper sculpture
Fold two strips into loops, then join the loops using the small slot in each strip. Tape is optional; the slots provide the join. The directions describe assembly but do not specify the sculpture's weight or a way to calculate it. The author is Iven Moss.
